'''TonKing23 Tauntaun's EBO with a vengeance''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TonKing23]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Hoth Main Power Generators (1st M Tauntaun.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a simple EBO deck I made to test its power in fun play, and so far It's lost twice of about 30 times. I've tested with lots of friends and they think I should take it to tourney.  Anyone have any suggestions or a rating?

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

A New Secret Base lets me get EBO out by the second turn, third if I have bad luck drawing characters, then I can get the planets and really start the beat down.  The defense of Hoth is really secondary afterwards, General Rieekan's there to prevent them from cancelling EBO, and Dodonna's there to pull pilots, then use Squadron Assignments to get their ships.  It's stood up every time against pure DS space, and Bacta Tank + Docking and Repair lets me save both ship and pilot.  I think the deck is pretty strong, but if you see a weakness please let me know.

Tauntaun with Lightsaber
